name: Identify 'Whale' customers in Spain (99th percentile spend).
python_code:
# Filter for Spain customers and drop rows with missing Customer ID
spain_df = df[df['Country'] == 'Spain'].copy()
spain_df = spain_df.dropna(subset=['Customer ID'])

# Calculate total spend per customer (Price * Quantity)
spain_df['TotalSpend'] = spain_df['Price'] * spain_df['Quantity']

# Aggregate total spend per customer
customer_spend = spain_df.groupby('Customer ID')['TotalSpend'].sum().reset_index()
customer_spend.columns = ['Customer ID', 'TotalSpend']

# Calculate the 99th percentile threshold
threshold = customer_spend['TotalSpend'].quantile(0.99)

# Identify Whale customers (those above the 99th percentile)
whale_customers = customer_spend[customer_spend['TotalSpend'] >= threshold].copy()

# Sort by spend descending
whale_customers = whale_customers.sort_values('TotalSpend', ascending=False)

result = whale_customers
